correctness.rationale: PASS: An independently coded full enumeration of all 4^8 oriented-outdegree choices produced exactly 23625 augmented faces with f=(24,240,1296,4080,7488,7424,3072), and agreement with oriented rooted forest interpretation. Greedy matching on the 24 incidence symbols leaves 11697 pairs, critical cells {0:1,5:47,6:182}; complete Hasse DAG visited every 23624 nonempty face and 124176 face-cover arrows, proving acyclicity (not a sample). Independent signed Morse boundary calculation gives a 47×182 integer matrix with 334 entries ±1 and 43 consecutive unimodular unit pivots, leaving an exactly zero 4×139 submatrix. Hence the full integral attaching degrees and no torsion. Since five-skeleton is ∨47 S5, Hurewicz π5≅H5 makes all six-cell attaching classes their degree columns; unit cancellations yield the homotopy wedge. The prior mod2 ranks alone do not establish this result.
